verdict.rationale: Segment documents an Identity Resolution / ID Graph that merges cookie IDs, device IDs, emails, and custom external IDs across web, mobile, server, and third-party touch-points into a single profile in real time, with Engage/Audiences and Profile API built on top for querying resolved profiles. Configurability of ID resolution rules is implied via external_ids/traits/spec but not deeply detailed with concrete rule-configuration examples. Missing for 10: hands-on/independent validation of identity stitching accuracy, and more granular documentation on customizing merge/precedence rules.
